Memory.title: Memory
Memory.description: An episodic memory, fact, preference, or context item stored from conversations with the AI companion.

category.description: Category of the memory (e.g. preference, project, technical, personal, bug, general).

summary.description: Concise summary of the remembered fact or note.

detail.description: Detailed description or context of the memory.

createdAt.description: Timestamp when this memory was recorded.

pinned.description: Whether this memory is pinned as a high-priority context.

/memories/{memoryId}.description: Persistent store of episodic memories and notes saved by or for the AI companion.
